Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ajay - 35 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Shalini - 25 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Neeta - 61 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The terrace - Day

[Shalini stands on the terrace. Ajay and Neeta stand near her.]

Ajay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Shalini hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Ajay: "Let's see."

[Ajay ties a letter to the pigeon and lets it fly.]

Shalini (happily): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ajay reads the letter the pigeon brought.]

Ajay: "Well done!"

[Ajay falls from the ladder and hurts his leg.]

Shalini: "Oh wow!"

[Ajay falls from the roof and dies.]

Neeta: "We have to be strong now."
